blocks.text: The module documentation limits this file to answering which names run and in what order, leaving resolution and execution to other modules. Static tier, mode, directed-route, and group-size constants follow.
blocks.title: Graph-router boundary

blocks.anchor: def build_execution_graph(tier: int, directed_task_type: str = None, run_tests: bool = False) -> list:
blocks.text: build_execution_graph returns responder, lean, or directed subsets, optionally appending the lean sandbox tester. Unknown tiers and incomplete or unknown directed routes raise.
blocks.title: Static tier graphs

blocks.text: sanitize_parallel_groups validates hired/order membership, approval exclusions, overlap, deduplication, and group size before collapsing accepted groups at their earliest order position.
blocks.title: Parallel-group safety gate

blocks.anchor: def build_execution_graph_from_hires(hires: list, execution_order: list = None) -> tuple:
blocks.text: The hires builder optionally sorts by execution order, records role-keyed account overrides, resolves single roles, and collapses staffed multi-role groups into generic-worker concurrent slots.
blocks.title: Hires to executable slots

blocks.text: validate_registry_coverage gathers every static route name and raises if any is missing from REGISTRY.
blocks.title: Registry invariant

blocks.text: capability_registration_gaps compares referenced route names with capability entries and returns sorted gaps without making incomplete capability seeds fatal.
blocks.title: Capability diagnostics

gotchas: Tier 3 is not in the static TIERS map.
Parallel groups containing approval roles are rejected.
Unordered hires are appended after explicitly ordered roles.
how_it_works: Selects static tier or directed graphs
purpose: This module answers which agent roles run and in what order; it does not execute them. It supports lean and directed tiers, turns vetted parallel proposals into nested execution order, maps hires to resolved agents and account overrides, and exposes validation diagnostics.
summary: Builds tier and directed-task execution graphs, sanitizes concurrent groups, and checks registry or capability coverage.

symbols.summary: Returns the ordered static agent graph for tier 0, tier 1, or a directed tier-2 task.
Collects role names from flat and nested execution-order entries.
Filters proposed concurrent groups and inserts only safe accepted groups into execution order.
Maps staffed roles to resolved agents, ordered role slots, and role-keyed account overrides.
Raises if any static tier or directed graph agent name is absent from the registry.
Returns referenced graph names missing from the capability registry without failing routing.

unknowns: Actual agent execution and role resolution behavior belongs to executor and registry modules.
